annotations.title: Solunar periods: lunar transits, moonrise and moonset

description: Solunar periods for a place and day: major periods around the Moon's upper and lower transits, minor periods around moonrise and moonset, in local time. E.g. {date: '2026-06-21', latitude: 48.8566, longitude: 2.3522}. For fishing, hunting and outdoor apps that use the solunar timing convention: for one local day at a place, each major period (centred on the Moon's upper transit overhead and lower transit underfoot, 2 h by default) and minor period (centred on moonrise and moonset, 1 h by default) with its start, centre and end in local time, the Moon's altitude at its transits and its phase. The events are exact (astronomy/rise-set conventions); the windows are the convention's, adjustable. No rating attached. Deterministic (JPL DE440, no LLM); every result carries meta.result_sha256. Price $0.01 per call via REST POST https://astro-agent.dev/v1/astronomy/solunar (x402 or MPP); each client gets 1 free call on the $0.01-0.02 tools, this one included.

date.description: The local calendar day at the place, YYYY-MM-DD (1800-01-02..2199-12-30).

elevation_m.description: Height above the WGS84 ellipsoid, metres (no terrain or horizon dip is modelled).

major_minutes.description: Length of a major period, centred on a lunar transit.

minor_minutes.description: Length of a minor period, centred on moonrise or moonset.

timezone.description: IANA zone for local times, e.g. 'Europe/Paris'. Optional: resolved from the coordinates (with its historical DST rules).

name: solunar_periods

accepts.description: x402 offer only: the payment options (scheme, network, amount, asset, payTo, ...).

endpoint.description: The REST route that computed it, e.g. 'astronomy/rise-set'.

error.description: x402 offer only: why payment is required.

deterministic.description: Always true: same input, same result.

llm_used.description: Always false: no language model is involved.

payment.description: How this call was paid: protocol ('free' or 'none'), price and the free calls remaining.

reproducibility.description: How to reproduce and check this result.

result_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical 'result'; check it with verify_result_hash.

resource.description: x402 offer only: the resource being paid for.

counts.description: Number of major and minor periods that day.

moon.description: The Moon's phase at mid-day: name, illuminated_fraction, age_days.

periods.description: In time order: {type: major | minor, event: upper_transit | lower_transit | moonrise | moonset, centre, start, end (each {utc, local, timestamp}), moon_altitude (transits)}.

subject.description: The place, its time zone, the local date and the day's window in UTC.
